text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Expected years of schooling among girls and boys in pre-primary
For each year, this shows how many years a child starting school then can expect to spend in pre-primary education if
current enrollment patterns stay the same. It includes repeated grades.
